payload.name: set_do_not_disturb
payload.description: Place a Do-Not-Disturb hold on an in-house guest's room when they ask not to be disturbed / to hold their calls and messages. It's a standing hold (until lifted), not a one-off like a single message or a wake-up call. Take the room number. Always tell the guest that a genuine emergency or hotel safety matter still overrides DND.
